verdicts.rationale: POST /schema accepts replicationConfig.factor=-1 (negative value) and returns HTTP 200, silently correcting it to factor=1. 源码 usecases/replica/config.go lines 44-46 显示 ValidateConfig() 在 factor < 1 时静默赋值修正,不返回错误.这违反了 contract requirement (replicationConfig.factor >= 1) 和 parameter validation best practices.用户发送非法参数应收到 422 error 而非静默修正后的成功响应.
